verdict.rationale: Edge0's documented server is started for a single model (`edge0 serve edge0-35b`). The evidence shows no way to load additional models or switch between them at runtime without restarting. The claim that one read-only base serves multiple adapter sets covers LoRA adapters, not multiple models. Adapter file swaps are an adjacent feature, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and switch between multiple models without restarting the server
